prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent overhead battle-map token of the exact GM-approved Bit-boy mimic in image 1. Image 2 supplies the STEEP OVERHEAD CAMERA and painted token format ONLY; do not copy its person, clothes, hair, equipment or weapon.
Preserve the extremely thin hunched humanoid monster, grey wispy hair, overlong almost-human face, badly rehearsed grin, narrow elongated hands and incorrectly worn mismatched brown/olive clothing layers. One shoulder misaligned with the overcoat, lining and shirt layers protruding from wrong gaps, inside-out/misbuttoned cardigan, unequal trouser hems and worn mismatched shoes. This remains a NONHUMAN CREATURE poorly impersonating an old man; do not normalize its proportions into a friendly ordinary grandfather. Two actual arms and two legs, one inviting/beckoning hand extended a little toward the SOUTH/front, other hand loose. No staff, armour, weapon, extra limb, horn, blood or wounds.
Camera almost directly above, around 85 degrees above ground: crown, shoulder tops and upper garment surfaces dominate; only a short foreshortened part of its false face, torso front and legs. Front/head/gaze toward BOTTOM / SOUTH, rear toward TOP / NORTH. Not a front portrait or a sideways figure. Same naturalistic hand-painted earthy palette, broad readable cloth masses and restrained upper-left light. Keep every fingertip and shoe inside square margins. Genuine transparent alpha, no ground, floor, shadow disc, scene, frame, ring, checkerboard, white background or text.
